title: TunnelPickaxe
description: You can mine 3x3 with a pickaxe and a shovel and can break trees with a axe
body:
- Hold an Pickaxe or an Shovel in your mainhand use /tunnel for 3x3 mode on The Pickaxe or The Shovel
- Hold an Axe in your mainhand use /treebreaker for Treebreak mode on the Axe
- Disable effect by sneaking

**Permissions**:
- tunnel.use: makes that Players can use the abality 3x3 default enabled for Players
- tunnel.tree: makes that Players can use the abality Treebreaker default enabled for Players
- tunnel.admin: makes that Players can use /tunnel default only OP
- tunnel.tree.admin: makes that Players can use /treebreaker default only OP
